premises.text: Current orthotics are expensive and time-consuming, while off-the-shelf insoles provide inadequate support.
premises.evidence_span: orthotics prescription orthotics cost around four hundred dollars they're not repeatable... off-the-shelf insoles super accessible... but it's basically like putting a pillow in your shoe with absolutely no support
